sources.title: Ripple-65B Preview, a Frontier Open-Weight Model | Ricursive Intelligence
sources.snippet: We optimized the model architecture for our training and serving platforms, driving substantial efficiency gains. Today, we release Ripple-65B Preview, a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model that powers our AI chip design platform. The model is pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1M context length.
